WITH periods AS (
  SELECT 'current' AS period, TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01 00:00:00' AS start_ts, TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AS end_ts
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'base' AS period, TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01 00:00:00' AS start_ts, TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01 00:00:00' AS end_ts
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    p.period,
    AVG(i.total) AS avg_amount
  FROM periods p
  JOIN "public"."invoice" i
    ON i.invoice_date >= p.start_ts
   AND i.invoice_date < p.end_ts
   AND i.billing_country = 'Germany'
  GROUP BY p.period
)

  CASE
    WHEN b.avg_amount = 0 THEN NULL

  END AS yoy_growth_rate

CROSS JOIN agg b
